testimonials.title: What Our Users Say
testimonials.subtitle: Real experiences from clinicians and patients using our pneumonia detection tools

items.name: Dr. Ahmed Mohamed
items.text: The AI-assisted chest X‑ray analysis greatly improves pneumonia detection accuracy in our clinic. Fast, reliable, and integrates smoothly into our workflow.

items.name: Dr. Sarah Ahmed
items.text: Helps triage suspected pneumonia cases quickly so we can start treatment earlier — a real time-saver for emergency care.

items.name: Mohamed Ali
items.text: I received a prompt pneumonia assessment from my X‑ray and clear guidance on next steps. The team and reports were very helpful.

items.name: Dr. Fatima Hassan
items.text: Excellent tool for flagging pneumonia patterns on chest radiographs. The heatmaps and confidence scores support clinical decisions.
